case_study_packaging.headline: PE-backed dermatology network captures $1.18 million in annual savings and 6.2× ROI through Treya-led strategic sourcing
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Adult & Pediatric Dermatology, PC had grown to 38 clinics through acquisitions but still bought goods and services in a highly decentralized manner. Fragmented data, hundreds of vendors and pandemic-driven inflation were eroding margins just as Waud Capital Partners pressed for rapid EBITDA improvement. APDerm needed a partner that could quickly bring spend visibility, negotiate with sensitive incumbents, and unlock scale advantages across its indirect spend.
approach_summary: Analyzed 12 indirect spend categories representing roughly $6.3 million in annual addressable spend and cleansed fragmented AP data from 30+ systems.
Executed two waves of sourcing events—leveraging competitive RFPs, market baskets and benchmarking—to drive best-and-final offers in medical supplies, courier, janitorial and other services.
Optimized GPO tiers and dual-GPO strategy with McKesson, HealthTrust and Premier to secure 27 % savings on medical supplies while retaining incumbent distributor.
Renegotiated key incumbent contracts—including AthenaHealth billing (17 % reduction) and Enterprise Cleaning (20 % reduction)—to avoid operational disruption while lowering cost.
Consolidated vendors (e.g., telecom circuits aggregated under OneSource, WB Mason contract for office supplies) and instituted centralized contracts, SLAs and governance cadence.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya secured $1,179,965 in validated annual run-rate savings—more than triple the $380K minimum guarantee and delivering a 6.2× return on the firm’s $190K fixed fee. Quick-win programs in parcel shipping and office supplies went live within 60 days, and six categories are already fully implemented. Beyond the dollars, APDerm now benefits from centralized contracts, standardized pricing across 33+ sites and new supplier SLAs that free clinical staff from administrative tasks.
where_we_were_unique: Generated first realized savings within 60 days via GPO quick-wins and express contract execution.
Deep healthcare GPO expertise unlocked dual-GPO strategy that preserved incumbent relationships while maximizing rebates.
‘Soft-touch’ negotiation approach retained critical incumbent suppliers, mitigating change-management risk for front-line clinics.
Data-driven methodology cleansed decentralized AP data to create the first enterprise-wide spend baseline for leadership.
